apigenin: NIH DSLD groups 222 and 6916 share the apigenin name
Group 6916 includes glycoside/extract aliases that must not inherit aglycone findings

baseline.eligibility_limit: Inventory identity is not approved status, exposure validation or equivalence of products.

verdict: No qualified direct BUBR1-restoration or chromosome-fidelity benefit emerged from these returned and inspected sources. This is a bounded finding, not a global absence claim. Do not change nominees or add efficacy identities automatically.

beta_lapachone.identity: beta-lapachone, a quinone bought from Santa Cruz Biotechnology; product/catalog/purity not supplied. Not alpha-lapachone, an oxime derivative, whole lapacho bark or tea.

exposure.in_cells: 10 micromolar in culture, DMSO comparator; 16HBE and ARPE19 time series 0,5,15,30,60,120 min; TrHBMEC 0,15,30,60,120 min. Nucleotide endpoint at 2 h in 16HBE.
exposure.combination_control: 1 micromolar olaparib pretreatment 30 min then coexposure 2 h; DMSO 0.01% specified for pretreatment comparator. Not isolated beta-lapachone benefit.
exposure.models: Human bronchial epithelial 16HBE, ARPE19 retinal epithelial line, transformed human bone marrow endothelial TrHBMEC; no primary patient-derived MVA model, animal, muscle or clinical outcome. ARPE19 appears in Results/figures but detailed culture provenance is not supplied in inspected Methods.

actual_observations.direction: Both depleted by beta-lapachone alone; olaparib coexposure prevents NAD+ depletion, not NADH oxidation.
actual_observations.units: pmol/mg protein; Fig4C mean±SD, n=3; no P value/CI or replicate independence definition supplied
actual_observations.mechanistic_limit: An oxidized ratio is not an increase in total usable NAD+ supply. No numerical effect reconstructed from bars.

actual_observations.direction: Increased accessibility to C-terminal/A180 antibodies after treatment; A180 fluorescence higher at 30/120 min.
actual_observations.limit: Non-denaturing epitope reactivity; no NQO1 increase in accompanying denaturing protein-expression blot (S2). No quantified fluorescence effect/denominator/statistical test supplied despite prose saying significant.

actual_observations.direction: Authors report no increase during 2 h; S2 includes beta-actin controls and all three lines.
actual_observations.limit: Representative blot, no densitometry/P/equivalence claim. TrHBMEC later NQO1 bands visibly weaker; do not quantify or call a statistically established decrease.

actual_observations.direction: Observed in untreated cells in Figs8/9
actual_observations.limit: Not beta-lapachone-induced Sirt2 activation, mitotic completion, segregation fidelity, BUBR1 abundance, BUBR1 deacetylation or protein half-life.

missing_endpoints: BUB1B RNA or BubR1 protein assay
Cell viability or clinical safety outcome in this experiment
mechanism_limits: NQO1*2 recombinant mutant and NQO1 siRNA are separate validation interventions, not drug rescue.
Reduced NADH protects recombinant NQO1 against trypsin; this does not measure beta-lapachone stabilization of BubR1.
Potential local NQO1 provision of NAD+ to Sirt2 is a hypothesis in the Discussion; no direct local flux or drug-induced Sirt2 activity measurement.
Dicumarol blocks antibody binding in recombinant NQO1 assays; this adds no independent therapeutic rescue to its existing ledger entry.
beta_lapachone.role: Useful redox/antibody-readout mechanistic caution, with adverse NAD-pool direction at the tested exposure; not nominated as a NAD-supply or BUBR1-restoration treatment. No inference of toxicity rate from depletion alone.
quality_limits: n=3 nucleotide measurements, biological independence unspecified
No allocated/masked design, sample-size plan, exact inferential test or CI established
Representative blots/images do not establish a quantified population effect
Authors DS/DR and University of Colorado license A180 antibody; NIH funded study with stated no funder role

apigenin.role: Mechanistic NAD/CD38 hypothesis with real administered-compound metabolic effects; not direct SIRT2/BUBR1 restoration in the examined passages. No treatment-fidelity benefit qualified.
apigenin.identity: Apigenin named Sigma reagent; no automatic transfer to apigenin glycosides, plant extracts or supplement mixtures.
apigenin.exposure_and_positive: A549 dose-response NAD experiments at 6 h and 25 micromolar PBS time-course; WT/CD38-KO MEF NAD comparison at 25 micromolar for 6 h. Obese C57BL/6 mice after 4-week high-fat diet randomized 6/group to 100 mg/kg/day intraperitoneal apigenin or DMSO for 7 days. Hepatic NAD+ increased and CD38 activity/global acetylation decreased; glucose and hepatic lipid endpoints improved, reported P<.05, no exact effects/CI qualified. Mouse sex not established in the selected Methods.
counterpoints: No direct recombinant SIRT1 activation (0–100 micromolar).
No further NAD+ increase in CD38-knockout MEFs; CD38 genetics is not treated BUBR1 evidence.
Liver SIRT1/CD38/Nampt expression not significantly changed; activity/deacetylation is not protein supply.
No group difference in food intake/body weight over treatment.
HepG2 25 micromolar apigenin/6 h effects opposed by 10 micromolar EX527 support SIRT1 involvement, not SIRT2 interchangeability.
No direct BubR1/checkpoint/fidelity assay in examined source sections; full other sections/supplement not reviewed, so not a whole-source validated null.

additional_abstract_pointers.positive: Actual apigenin culture and prenatal/lifelong chow treatment improves oxidative/developmental and some sex-dependent mouse behavioral outcomes.
additional_abstract_pointers.limit: Down-syndrome phenotype modulation, not chromosome-21 removal or demonstrated faithful chromosome segregation. Abstract reports no significant birth-defect/pup-death increase, not proven safety; dose/n/P/CI/full methods unqualified.

additional_abstract_pointers.positive: Porcine postovulatory in-vitro aging abstract reports less oxidative stress and improved embryo development with apigenin, SIRT1 upregulation.
additional_abstract_pointers.limit: Not demonstrated SIRT2/BubR1 restoration; abstract does not supply a measured aneuploidy improvement. Dose/n/full figures unqualified.

fair_competitive_judgment: No requirement for proven MVA efficacy is applied selectively. Apigenin has a plausible NAD-sparing intervention and real metabolic/other-model phenotype signals, but no examined compound-to-SIRT2/BubR1 bridge or muscle/fidelity result comparable to the existing NMN source context. Beta-lapachone at this exposure depletes NAD pools. These sources therefore do not justify replacing provisional nominations. Apigenin could be a bounded direct-assay comparator if further experimental prioritization is wanted; no efficacy nomination follows automatically.
source_reviewer_scope: Apigenin and beta-lapachone, six-query bounded discovery; one mechanistic primary qualified

apigenin_primary.preparation: Named Sigma-Aldrich apigenin reagent; catalog/purity not reported in inspected Methods; no glycoside/extract/product equivalence
apigenin_primary.mouse_design: 12 C57BL/6 mice, 20 weeks old before 4 weeks HFD; randomized 6/group to 100 mg/kg i.p. apigenin daily or DMSO for 7 days on continued HFD; mouse sex not established
apigenin_primary.cell_exposures: A549 6-hour dose-response; 25 micromolar PBS protection; WT/KO MEFs 25 micromolar 6 hours; HepG2 apigenin 25 micromolar with EX527 10 micromolar in separate assays
positive_outcomes: hepatic NAD+ increase and CD38 activity decrease, n=6/group P<.05
hepatic global acetylation decrease, n=3/group P<.05
fed/fasting glucose and selected glucose-tolerance timepoint positives, n=6/group P<.05
hepatic triglycerides decrease and LCAD/MCAD mRNA increase, n=6/group P<.05
HepG2 lipid/deacetylation effects opposed by EX527
precision_limits: Native Fig7D AUC numerically lower without significance annotation, exact P or CI
Triglycerides and transcripts do not directly measure fatty-acid oxidation flux
CD38 knockout has higher baseline NAD and its own control normalization; ceiling and nonexclusive targeting remain possible
p65 acetylation is undetectable in control KO, not evaluable for further apigenin response
EX527 cellular experiments do not establish in-vivo SIRT1 mediation
No direct recombinant SIRT1 activation; no SIRT2 assay
Liver protein nonchanges are representative blots, not quantified equivalence
apigenin_primary.harms_and_design_limits: No systematic harm ascertainment, primary hierarchy, sample-size plan, masking, concealment or tissue exposure established; no food-intake/body-weight difference is not safety equivalence; small short study with multiple endpoints; no graph-digitized effect estimates

beta_lapachone_primary.preparation: Santa Cruz beta-lapachone; product/catalog/purity unspecified; not alpha-lapachone or bark/tea
beta_lapachone_primary.exposure: 10 micromolar in cells, 0–120-minute timecourses; NAD endpoint 16HBE at 2 hours; olaparib 1 micromolar 30 minutes pretreatment then coexposure
actual_effects: NADH and NAD+ depleted with beta-lapachone alone
Olaparib rescues NAD+ pool but not NADH in combination
NQO1 IP and A180 staining increase through epitope accessibility
S2 shows no established NQO1 abundance increase
inferences_not_outcomes: Untreated Sirt2/NQO1/tubulin colocalization is not drug-induced Sirt2 function
Local NAD+ provision is a Discussion hypothesis
Trypsin protection with NADH is a different intervention
NAD depletion is not a measured cytotoxicity rate
beta_lapachone_primary.numeric_scope: Fig4C mean±SD n=3; no exact P/CI or independent-biological-replicate definition; staining/blots lack quantitative inferential effects
